newsitem.title: CANADA: Golden Knight closes acquistion, financing.
newsitem.headline: Golden Knight closes acquistion, financing.

text.p: Golden Knight Resources Inc said on Wednesday it acquired the additional 12.5 percent interest in Gold Fields Ghana Ltd and issued nine million special warrants in a private placement totaling C$74.25 million.

Golden Knight said it issued the special warrants at a price of C$8.25 per special warrant to institutional investors and Teck Corp. Each special warrant is exchangeable without additional payment into one common share of Golden Knight on the filing and regulatory approval of a prospectus, which qualifies for trading the shares to be issued.
The price represents a five percent discount to the closing price of Golden Knight's common shares on August 30.

Golden Knight acquired the additional stake in Gold Fields Ghana from Aruba-based Cabo Frio Investments AVV for US$47 million plus future consideration for additional gold reserves and resources, it said.

Gold Fields Ghana holds the mining rights to the Tarkwa Concession in Ghana where recent exploration delineated gold resources of 324 million in-situ tons grading 0.040 ounces of gold a ton or 13 million ounces.
